_readme: Add a hackathon by appending an object to "projects". Fields: id, name, summary, categories (Research, Agents, Tools, Apps), event, eventType, eventUrl (official event page), submissionUrl (her writeup or submission page), videoUrl (optional; all videos are also in the YouTube playlist set in playlistUrl), date (ISO, sorts the lists), dateLabel (shown), dateBasis, verified, image (optional, under assets/img), links {repo, demo, space, listing}. Leave a URL as an empty string when there isn't one. Set verified to false to hide an entry. The counts on every page are computed from the entries with verified: true.
